name: DollaTek RP2040 Core Board TYPE-C USB-C (sold as 16M)

validation.source: seller listing and the user's photo of the board; no physical board tested yet

labels.dp: GP0 (left edge, pin 1 from the USB-C end)

ground_reference: left edge pin 3 (GND, between GP1 and GP2)
left edge pin 8 (GND, between GP5 and GP6)

reserved_gpios.23: unknown on this board: on YD-RP2040-style boards it drives the central RGB (WS2812) LED; never driven
reserved_gpios.24: unknown on this board: on YD-RP2040-style boards it is the USR button; never driven

notes: Flash: the declared 16 MB is not trusted. boot2 is the slow but universal generic_03h, the image is linked for 2 MB and runs from RAM (copy_to_ram), so neither the flash chip nor its size affects timing. The firmware reads the real JEDEC ID and SFDP size at boot and reports them (fm1-board-tool probe).
LED: GP25 according to the photo; polarity assumed active-high and unverified. The firmware works the same with the LED absent or inverted (build with -DFM1T_LEDS=OFF to leave GP25 untouched).
The central RGB component is not used. Its interface (WS2812 on GP23 on similar boards) is not assumed.
